credits.t: The realm of DRAGONSLEEP, Silverton and the corridor, its people, its places and its names are Griz's.
Code, the 8-bit game's pixel art, chiptunes and connective text written for this game. Nothing copied from any other game.

This work includes material taken from the System Reference Document 5.1 ("SRD 5.1") by Wizards of the Coast LLC and available at https://dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document. The shape of the thing: the old turn-based console RPGs. The shape only.
Made from these, changed for this game (each rigged, posed, coloured and cut to the palette):
The xorn, the grick, the troll and the stone giants: models by mz4250 (Thingiverse), CC BY 4.0 / CC BY. The roper: "Roper 2025" by mz4250, CC BY-SA, so its sheet is shared alike.

The people: the Liberated Pixel Cup (LPC) figures by bluecarrot16, JaidynReiman, wulax, Redshrike, ElizaWy, BenCreating, Nila122, makrohn and their fellows, CC-BY-SA 3.0 / GPL 3.0 / OGA-BY 3.0, shared alike.

KayKit (Kay Lousberg), Quaternius and br-n518: CC0, credited gladly. Denny, the chuul, the gnolls, the cloaker, the ettercap, the otyugh, the hyena, the bulette, the owls, the boar and the crawler: sheets generated by Griz (the chuul and the crawler with Grok).
